items.name: Dispatch Work
items.offer: Dispatch Work — 2X GTA$ & RP
items.requirements: Freemode → your owned Law Enforcement personal vehicle. First complete Slush Fund from The Cluckin’ Bell Farm Raid as leader. While driving your Law Enforcement vehicle, request Dispatch Work with the displayed prompt (R3/RS on console, B on PC). Follow Vincent’s assigned mission markers; there is no single fixed destination.

items.offer: Standard and Most Wanted Bail Office Targets — 2X GTA$ & RP
items.requirements: Your owned Bail Office → bounty selection. Start the bounty from your Bail Office and follow the assigned target markers. Standard and Most Wanted targets have different availability; check the current target selection and the exact weekly challenge below. Dispatch Work is a separate activity and does not substitute for securing a Bail Office bounty.

items.name: Halloween Weekly Challenges Completion Bonus
items.offer: Halloween Weekly Challenges Completion Bonus — Complete all five Weekly Challenges during October 1–November 4 to receive GTA$2,000,000 within 72 hours of completion.
items.requirements: Complete all five weekly challenges to earn an extra GTA$2,000,000. Paid within 72 hours of completing all five; Payphone Hits is separate. Week 1 (2026-10-01–2026-10-07): Secure two Bail Office Bounties; GTA$100,000 and Green Vintage Skull Mask. Week 2 (2026-10-08–2026-10-14): Win two Adversary Modes; GTA$100,000 and Pink Skull Emissive Mask. Week 3 (2026-10-15–2026-10-21): Win three Races; GTA$100,000 and Orange Glow Skeleton Onesie. Week 4 (2026-10-22–2026-10-28): Complete all waves of a Survival; GTA$150,000 and Gray Space Interloper Outfit. Week 5 (2026-10-29–2026-11-04): Complete 10 waves in a Survival without dying; GTA$250,000 and Slasher Clown Outfit.
